name: Fenugreek seed
description: Bitter golden seed; hilba tea and methi tempering.

unani.note: Textbook garam — hilba is a winter drink.

nutrition.highlight: bitter until toasted, and then it turns nutty

effects.note: The seed's soluble fibre (galactomannan) slows carbohydrate absorption — a meta-analysis of ten trials in type 2 diabetes found real reductions in fasting glucose and HbA1c, but the effect is dose-dependent the other way round from most doses in this app: low doses under 5g a day showed no significant benefit, with the reductions only appearing at medium-to-high doses, up toward 25g a day. That's well past a light tempering's worth — closer to a dedicated daily dose than a seasoning. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
